gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Drives StrSubstitutor with stubbed collaborators so its prefix/suffix scanning follows a fixed, scripted path. The variable resolver always returns "fYxE", and
ADDED i2: Variable resolver: every variable name resolves to the literal "fYxE".
ADDED i3: Matcher used for both prefix and suffix. isMatch returns a scripted sequence of match lengths (0 = no match) that steers the substitutor through the source text
ADDED i4: Use the same matcher for prefix and suffix, with '1' as the escape character.
ADDED i5: Replace within the 5-char window starting at offset 1 of the source string.
ADDED i6: Re-running over the resolver's own output yields no substitution this time.
ADDED i7: The escape character supplied to the constructor is preserved.
